name: USD / INR (dollar to rupee)
description: How many rupees one US dollar buys, using the FBIL reference rate, India's official benchmark for the rupee. A higher number means a weaker rupee. Market rates move through the day and can differ from the reference rate.
releaseSchedule: FBIL fixes the reference rate around 1:30 pm IST on each trading day. Updated automatically.

chart.title: The rupee recovered in mid-October
